warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects. (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.
notes: Front brand plate reads 'ZHIGULEVSKOYE'. The smaller logo repeated at the top left of the back reads 'ZHIGUILEVSKOYE', with an extra I after the U; the back's body text spells it 'ZHIGULEVSKOYE SPECIAL'. The reading above is the front, the principal display panel.
Net contents is printed as a dual declaration, '1 PT. 0.9 FL. OZ. (500 mL)', on both front and back, with a lower-case m and capital L in mL.
Back repeats the alcohol statement as 'ALC. 5.2% BY VOL.'
Warning is on the back in a white box, body in sentence case; the heading 'GOVERNMENT WARNING:' is bold capitals.
